business_summary: Shanghai SK Petroleum & Chemical Equipment Corporation Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, manufactures, and markets oil equipment in China and internationally. The company offers mud logging, high-temperature measurement while drilling (MWD) / logging while drilling (LWD), wireline logging, digital logging, drilling well control, and wellhead oil recovery services, as well as petrochemical equipment, such as general-purpose; automatic sample preparation; fuel oil; aviation fuel; and lubricating oil and grease test solution. It also provides oil drilling equipment, logging and drilling equipment and services, petroleum analyzers, logging instruments and services, and housing lease and property management services. In addition, the company offers instruments for geological exploration and seismic exploration; earthquake-specific instruments; experimental and analytical instruments; instruments and meters; geological exploration services; engineering and technical services; technology development, technical consulting, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion; import and export of goods; leasing of non-residential real estate; and technical labor services. It also exports its products to the Americas, the Middle East, Central Europe, Central Asia, South Asia, and Africa. Shanghai SK Petroleum & Chemical Equipment Corporation Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
